title: Gastroenterology & Hepatology in India
intro: Advanced digestive and liver care in India with expert gastroenterologists, hepatologists, and state-of-the-art endoscopic facilities. Panacea Medcare connects international patients to leading GI and liver care centers.

liver.title: Liver Disease & Cirrhosis Management
liver.description: Comprehensive liver disease treatment in India includes advanced management of cirrhosis, hepatitis, and liver failure with expert hepatology teams and state-of-the-art facilities.

endoscopy.title: Advanced Endoscopy & Colonoscopy
endoscopy.description: India offers advanced endoscopic procedures including colonoscopy, upper GI endoscopy, and therapeutic endoscopy for diagnosis and treatment of digestive disorders.

ercp.title: ERCP & EUS
ercp.description: Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) and Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) procedures in India provide precise diagnosis and treatment of pancreatic and biliary diseases.

ibd.title: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) Treatment
ibd.description: Specialized IBD treatment in India includes management of Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis with advanced medications, biologics, and surgical options when needed.

cancer.title: Gastrointestinal Cancer Surgery
cancer.description: Expert GI cancer surgery in India includes treatment for esophageal, gastric, colorectal, and pancreatic cancers using minimally invasive and robotic techniques.

bariatric.title: Bariatric & Metabolic Surgery
bariatric.description: Bariatric surgery in India helps patients achieve significant weight loss and manage metabolic conditions like type 2 diabetes with high success rates and comprehensive support.

pancreas.title: Pancreatic Disorders Treatment
pancreas.description: Pancreatic disorder treatment in India includes management of pancreatitis, pancreatic tumors, and pancreatic insufficiency with expert gastroenterology and surgical teams.

q1.question: What makes India a preferred destination for gastroenterology treatments?
q1.answer: India offers world-class gastroenterology care with JCI-accredited hospitals, internationally trained gastroenterologists, advanced endoscopic equipment, and comprehensive GI services at 60-70% lower costs compared to Western countries. Indian hospitals have expertise in complex procedures like ERCP, EUS, and advanced therapeutic endoscopy.

q2.question: How long does treatment for liver cirrhosis typically take in India?
q2.answer: Treatment duration varies based on severity. Initial evaluation takes 3-5 days, medical management is ongoing, while liver transplant evaluation and surgery require 4-6 weeks. India offers comprehensive cirrhosis management including medications, endoscopic procedures for varices, and liver transplantation with excellent outcomes.

q3.question: Are advanced endoscopic procedures like ERCP and EUS available in India?
q3.answer: Yes, leading Indian hospitals have state-of-the-art endoscopy suites with advanced procedures including ERCP for bile duct stones and strictures, EUS for pancreatic and GI cancers, endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR), and endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) performed by highly experienced gastroenterologists.

q4.question: What is the success rate of bariatric surgery in India?
q4.answer: Indian bariatric surgery centers report excellent outcomes with 70-80% excess weight loss, 80-90% diabetes remission rates, and complication rates below 2%. Comprehensive pre-operative evaluation, experienced surgeons, and structured follow-up programs ensure sustainable results.

q5.question: How is inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) managed in India?
q5.answer: India offers comprehensive IBD care including advanced diagnostics (colonoscopy, MR enterography), biologic therapies (infliximab, adalimumab), immunomodulators, and surgical options when needed. Multidisciplinary teams provide personalized treatment plans with regular monitoring and nutritional support.
